# webtools-ui

> Shared UI SDK and Design System for AI Systems Engineering Tools.

 provides the canonical look-and-feel, CSS design tokens, multi-skin theme architecture, and shared components (sidebar shell, topnav, tool cards, lifecycle flow ribbons, and modal drawers) across the entire 6-tool suite.

## Pages

- [Component Catalog / Index](pages/index.html): UI Component catalog and interactive demo environment

## SDK Architecture

- CSS Design System (): Modern tokens, dark/light skins, typography, responsive grid
- JavaScript Core (): Shared metadata catalog (), lifecycle flow navigation, carousel synchronization
